First public release.

An OpenWrt/LuCI app that records your cable modem's signal levels, error counters and event log every 5 minutes, so you can show your ISP or a regulator what's happening on the line. Tested with the Arris SURFboard S33 on OpenWrt 25.12.

**Highlights**
- Signal report with charts, daily summary, incidents and the modem's own event log (T3/T4 timeouts, DHCP/registration failures, upstream power warnings)
- Maintenance Log tab: technician visits, ISP calls, reboots and router changes are drawn as markers on every chart, with a 24-hour before/after comparison
- "Show data since": recount everything after a chosen repair
- Tells reboots apart from loss of signal / re-registration (by modem uptime)
- Reboot the modem from LuCI, logged with the exact time
- Router–modem Ethernet error counters, and NIC receive overruns tracked separately
- Download all data as one zip (MAC and public IP addresses masked)
- First install picks a storage location and retention period from the free space available

**Install (OpenWrt 25.x, apk)**
```sh
apk add --allow-untrusted luci-app-modem-monitor-1.1.1-r1.apk
```
Then open Status → Cable Modem → Settings, enter the modem password and click Test connection. See the README for details. For opkg-based OpenWrt (24.10 and older), build an .ipk with the SDK `Makefile` (untested).
